brand.tagline: The Vue component library behind Hikarinagi

actions.openSource: Open the Markdown source of this page
actions.prompt: Read {url} and get ready to answer my questions about the {title} component

typography.label: Typography
typography.description: How text, code, lists and quotations are set in body content.

layout.label: Layout
layout.description: Containers that arrange their children — direction, spacing and alignment.

atoms.label: Atoms
atoms.description: The smallest reusable units — buttons, tags and badges.

overlays.label: Overlays
overlays.description: Panels and hints that float above the page.

display.label: Display
display.description: Panels, containers and states that carry and present content.

data.label: Data
data.description: Components that organise and present sets of data in rows and columns.

navigation.label: Navigation
navigation.description: Components that show where you are and move you around the site.

guides.installation: Dependencies, style entry, fonts, dark mode and density

components.accordion: A list of sections that expand and collapse in turn
components.alert: A message bar that appears in the page after something happens
components.anchor: An in-page table of contents that tracks the section you are reading
components.badge: Pins an unread count to the corner of its host
components.breadcrumb: Shows where the current page sits in the hierarchy
components.button-group: Joins several buttons into one unit
components.card: Gathers a group of content onto one raised surface
components.code-block: A block of code with highlighting and copying
components.copy-button: Writes a piece of text to the clipboard
components.heading: Headings with semantics and size decoupled
components.icon-button: An icon-only button that requires a name
components.kbd: A keyboard key, for documenting shortcuts
components.link: A text link that can render as a router component
components.mark: Marks text, such as search hits
components.nav-link: One entry in a navigation list, marking the current page
components.number-format: Formats numbers for the current language
components.prose: A rich text container that styles native tags
components.splitter: Panes whose proportions are adjusted by dragging a divider
components.table: Static data organised into rows and columns
components.tabs: Several sets of content shown one at a time in the same place
components.tag: A short label for status, category or attribute
components.time: Displays time in the current language
components.dropdown-menu: A set of actions revealed on click
components.popover: A small panel that floats out on click
components.tooltip: A short note shown on hover or focus
components.dialog: A modal dialog that interrupts the current task
components.drawer: A modal panel that slides in from the screen edge
components.toast: Short feedback that floats in after an action
components.stack: Lays its children out in a single column
components.indicator: A small dot that shows a status
components.inline: Lays its children out in a row, wrapping when needed
components.avatar: A round portrait standing for a person or entity
components.flex: A flex container with full control over its axes
components.grid: A grid container with a fixed number of columns
components.simple-grid: An even grid whose columns follow a minimum width
components.container: Holds page content to a readable width and centres it
components.callout: A note written into the content
components.collapsible: A region a single trigger opens and closes
components.disclosure-icon: An indicator that turns as a region opens and closes
components.center: Centres its content on both axes
components.chip: An item that can be selected or removed
components.space: An empty element that takes up room in a flex container
components.aspect-ratio: Holds its content to a given width-to-height ratio
components.divider: A hairline that separates two pieces of content
components.scroll-area: A scrolling region with overlay scrollbars
components.skeleton: A placeholder that holds the shape of loading content
components.image: An image that loads lazily and falls back when it fails
